_comment: repop Y4 typed classification file for scripts/sleep_gate.py. The ONLY allowlist: files whose sleep primitives live inside one audited bounded poll implementation, are deadline schedulers (arming a timeout rejection, not waiting), or are macrotask yields (0ms tick). Growth of this file is a reviewed diff; every entry carries a reason. Inline per-site escapes use // SLEEP-CLASS: TIME-ADVANCE | POLL-STEP | SCHEDULING adjacent to the sleep.

files.reason: audited bounded-poll implementation (pollUntil): deadline-checked loop; the sleep primitive is the poll step under the deadline
audited bounded readiness poll (boot state machine): the sleep is a poll step inside the deadline-checked readiness loop
site line 177 is `await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 0))` — a macrotask yield (0ms tick), not a delay primitive; no time coordination
site line 43 arms the boot DEADLINE (setTimeout arming boot-deadline-exceeded rejection) — a deadline scheduler, not a delay; the deadline itself is the observable
site line 23 arms the same boot-deadline rejection in the browser test harness — deadline scheduler, not a delay primitive
site line 150 is a single 10ms bounded retry step inside the fake transport's receive helper (check() || resolve(null), bounded to one retry) — bounded poll step

functions.name: pollUntil
functions.reason: bounded poll step (deadline-checked pollUntil helper, ring/poll.ts + boot/boot-fsm.ts)
